headlines.title_en: Bank of Ghana Governor: Will promote local currency settlement in trade with China
headlines.summary_en: Bank of Ghana Governor Johnson Asiama said on the 24th that Ghana will cooperate with China to promote the elimination of third-party currency settlement in trade transactions between the two countries. Speaking at a news conference of the Monetary Policy Committee held that evening, Asiama said traders want to make full use of China's zero-tariff measure fully implemented for 53 African countries with diplomatic ties, and this key shift is crucial to strengthening bilateral trade between Ghana and China. Asiama disclosed that Ghana is establishing a cross-currency settlement channel between the Ghanaian cedi and the renminbi to eliminate the double foreign-exchange conversion and extra handling fees caused by third-party currencies. The central bank has approved Standard Bank's Ghana subsidiary, Stanbic Bank, and Ghana Commercial Bank, Ghana's largest domestic bank, to carry out a pilot project for a direct Ghana-China cross-currency settlement system. headlines.title_en: 10-year U.S. Treasury yield continues to hit a new high since 2007, up more than 16 basis points this week
headlines.summary_en: In late New York trading on Friday (September 25), the benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yield fell 3.74 basis points to 5.1604%, having approached the second-quarter 2007 high of 5.3228% early in the U.S. stock session, up 16.44 basis points for the week, with overall trading in the 4.9204%-5.2254% range. The two-year U.S. Treasury yield fell 7.27 basis points to 4.8516%, continuing to expand losses after a gap lower at 08:00 Beijing time, overall holding steady near the September 23 high of 4.9409% (approaching the April 30, 2024 high of 5.0434%), up 10.83 basis points for the week, with overall trading in the 4.6990%-4.9409% range, fluctuating narrowly at lows on September 21-22 and then fluctuating narrowly at highs after a significant rise on the 23rd.

headlines.title: 韩正会见联合国秘书长古特雷斯 出席全球发展倡议5周年高级别对话会
headlines.summary: 当地时间9月25日，国家副主席韩正在纽约出席联合国大会期间会见联合国秘书长古特雷斯，出席由中方主办的全球发展倡议5周年高级别对话会，宣读习近平主席贺信并致辞。 会见古特雷斯时，韩正表示，当前国际形势变乱交织，以联合国为核心的国际体系面临多重挑战。今年是新中国恢复联合国合法席位55周年。55年来，中国始终坚持真正的多边主义，支持联合国在国际事务中发挥核心作用。维护多边主义、改革完善全球治理体系是当前国际社会普遍呼声。面向未来，中国将继续发挥负责任大国作用，积极推进自身理念倡议同联合国议程对接，以中国式现代化新成就为世界发展提供新机遇。

headlines.title_en: Han Zheng meets with UN Secretary-General Guterres and attends the high-level dialogue on the 5th anniversary of the Global Development Initiative
headlines.summary_en: On September 25 local time, Vice President Han Zheng met with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres in New York during the United Nations General Assembly, attended the high-level dialogue on the fifth anniversary of the Global Development Initiative hosted by China, read out President Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter and delivered a speech. When meeting Guterres, Han Zheng said that the current international situation is intertwined with changes and turbulence, and the international system with the United Nations at its core faces multiple challenges. This year marks the 55th anniversary of the restoration of New China's lawful seat in the United Nations. Over the past 55 years, China has always upheld true multilateralism and supported the United Nations in playing a central role in international affairs. Safeguarding multilateralism and reforming and improving the global governance system are the common calls of the current international community. Looking ahead, China will continue to play the role of a responsible major country, actively promote the alignment of its own concepts and initiatives with the UN agenda, and provide new opportunities for world development with new achievements in Chinese modernization.
